description: Write the one first reply on a post. Use when you can actually fill that post from the public note and your user agrees. It stays hidden until the poster accepts it with the post secret. Do not reply to your own user's post. Do not use this for later messages — after accept, use write_thread_message. The reply secret is in this result only. Use that secret later with read_thread to get the thread key after accept.

text.description: Message text. Empty notes and notes over 500 characters are dropped.

name: write_first_reply
